summary: Analyzed hot hold demand forecast logic end-to-end: three inclusion gates (Active Menu, Line Build + Hot Hold Instruction AND, Launch Date), prediction algorithm (6-week vs 7-day MAX), Auto Solve 7* rule, pipeline timing (daily ~2 PM ET, data ready ~10 hours ahead), KDS-3613 integration with Sequencing. Wrote comprehensive cross-system analysis to cb-business/.
questions: Does the forecast update at midnight? Can a component item appear without hot hold instruction?
How far in advance is forecast data populated?
learned: Forecast pipeline runs once daily in the evening (~2 PM ET), data available ~10 hours before business day opens. At 0:00, data already exists — no midnight update.
Component must satisfy BOTH line build is_hot_hold_eligible_selected AND have hot_holds instructions configured — AND relationship, not OR.
614 items have is_hot_hold_eligible_selected=TRUE but 0 have hot_holds because they are different item_number types (800* vs 41*/70*/88*).
Table is full refresh (not partitioned), version_effective ensures single source of truth per date.
All 9735 forecast rows have valid retherm_time and holding_time — no item enters forecast without hot hold instructions.
thinking: The gap between eligible line build items and items with hot_holds configured reveals a potential operational blind spot — line build says hot hold eligible but no instruction means no KDS task.
followups: Verify whether the 614 items with hot hold eligible but no instruction should be flagged as a data quality issue in Cookbook.
